data.one_liner: Customizable Flutter widget to fetch and render URL link previews.
data.what_it_does: Extracts the first URL from given text, automatically fetches metadata such as title, description, and image, and displays it in a clean animated card. It supports rendering from cache and international domains.
use_when: Building chat applications that need URL preview cards
Displaying rich metadata cards for shared links
avoid_when: You only need to open links in a browser without preview UI
You need complex web-scraping features outside standard link metadata
strengths: Automatic preview generation and smart image layout
Supports international domains and custom tap handling
Includes cache support to avoid redundant network requests
weaknesses: Limited to rendering previews for the first URL found in text
Relies on network requests to fetch metadata from external sites
